note: Vocabulary keys with no per-100g row. Each stays unresolved unless a cited FDC row is the same product; candidates list the FDC rows considered and rejected during the 2026-10 nutrition-completion pass (see UNRESOLVED_CANDIDATES in data/recipes/tools/build_vocab.py).

ackee.note: no FDC row under any searched name (ackee, blighia); Jamaican specialty

artichoke_hearts.note: raw/frozen globe artichoke rows are the edible portion without the brine the drained jarred hearts imply; a raw row would understate sodium

beef_meatballs.note: the FNDDS row carries sauce and the SR row is seasoned Italian-style frozen; neither is plain beef meatballs

beef_vegetable_stock.note: surface is 'beef or vegetable stock'; both single-species rows are different products

black_bean_paste.note: fermented black-soybean paste; no FDC row (searched tausi, douchi, black bean paste)

black_vinegar.note: balsamic is grape must, a different product; no Chinese black (Chinkiang) vinegar row

callaloo_greens.note: callaloo greens are species-ambiguous (taro/amaranth/dasheen); no single-product FDC row

chicharrones.note: no pork-rind row in FNDDS 2024 or SR Legacy

chilli_sauce.note: surface is 'sweet chili sauce'; the tomato chili sauce and hot chile sauce rows are different products

dashi.note: kombu + bonito infusion; no FDC row

doenjang.note: Korean fermented soybean paste; no FDC row (miso is a different product)

doubanjiang.note: fermented chili-bean paste; no FDC row

egusi_seeds.note: melon/cucurbit seed kernels; no FDC row (searched melon seed, egusi)

farro.note: Foundation Foods 'Farro, pearled, dry, raw' carries no energy measurement in kcal in the bulk CSVs; pinning it would emit kcal 0.0

five_spice_powder.note: Chinese spice blend; no FDC row

galangal.note: no FDC row (ginger is a different plant)

garam_masala.note: North Indian spice blend; no FDC row

gochugaru.note: Korean coarse chili flakes; the ground cayenne spice and whole sun-dried chile rows are different products

gochujang.note: Korean chili-soybean paste; no FDC row

green_curry_paste.note: FNDDS 'Curry sauce' is a different (British-style) product

green_papaya.note: the raw/canned papaya rows are the ripe fruit; unripe green papaya differs materially in sugar

halloumi.note: no halloumi row; feta and mozzarella are different products

harissa.note: no harissa row in FNDDS 2024 or SR Legacy

jerk_seasoning.note: Jamaican spice blend; no FDC row

kaffir_lime.note: makrut lime leaves; no FDC row

labneh.note: Greek yogurt rows are less-strained and materially lower in energy; not the same product

massaman_curry_paste.note: FNDDS 'Curry sauce' is a different product

mirin.note: the sake row is unsweetened; mirin's sugar content differs materially

nduja.note: spreadable spicy cured pork; no FDC row

pomegranate_molasses.note: cane molasses is a different product; no pomegranate-reduction row

potato_starch.note: no standalone potato-starch row (hits are composite breads)

ras_el_hanout.note: North African spice blend; no FDC row

rice_powder.note: surface is 'toasted rice powder' (khao khua); the untoasted rice flour rows are a different product

rice_vinegar.note: the FNDDS generic 'Vinegar' row is not the rice-vinegar product; no rice vinegar row

scotch_bonnet.note: generic hot red chili row; the named variety is not represented

sichuan_peppercorns.note: no FDC row (searched sichuan, szechuan pepper)

spring_roll_wrappers.note: wonton wrappers contain egg; wheat-only spring roll wrappers are a different product

star_anise.note: anise seed is a different plant (shared aroma compound only)

stock.note: all FDC stock rows are species-specific (beef/chicken/fish); the surface names no species

sweet_potato_noodles.note: the cellophane rows are mung-bean starch, not sweet-potato starch (dangmyeon)

thai_chilies.note: generic hot red chili row; the named variety is not represented

zaatar.note: Middle Eastern herb blend; no FDC row
